svg.title: The signals that started the conversation
svg.text: They’d pay ≈£15k a year to fix it by hand
but I rang four times before anyone
2 of the last 11 reviews mention the phone
Customers notice, and say so in public
Lisa: “Craig’s on a job, can I take a message?”
Wrenfield is a limited company, so a short B2B email with a clear opt-out is allowed under PECR.
